description: Returns what Overfit offers: products, typical user wishes mapped to the matching tool, documentation URLs, and `planned`, the list of upcoming features (e.g. sign-in and credit from the chat, API keys, tender alerts, data packages) with one value sentence each. When the user wants a planned feature, register it with interesse_melden. Use when the user asks what Overfit offers, what is coming, or where the docs are. No parameters needed.
name: overfit_catalog
title: Was bietet Overfit?
